name: foo-http
description: HTTP, REST, and WebSocket networking for Foo.
readme: Build native HTTP clients and servers with a small sentence-like API.
The package includes routing, streaming bodies, connection pooling, TLS, and WebSocket upgrades.
All public operations return explicit results and integrate with Foo sequences for asynchronous work.
